title: The {\em 4DLO} and other tubing models of $S^3$ symmetry
summary: The {\em Four-dimensional Light Orchestra} or {\em 4DLO} was an interactive sculpture at the National Museum of Mathematics (MoMath) from November 20, 2025 through January 2026, illustrating various sub-symmetries of the 24-cell with colored lights. This was part of a larger sequence of tubing sculptures aiming to bring to life a few lines of tables appearing in~\cite{conwayandsmith}, reprinted in~\cite{sot}, and further illuminated in~\cite{rastanawi}.
